title: Coins and the bank
summary: Your purse and your bank: how coins are kept, the daily interest, and how to pay another player.

s.x: The 1% hits the cap at a balance of 500,000 coins. Keeping more than that earns the same 5,000. You need at least 100 coins in the bank to earn a whole coin. Your very first login, with an empty bank, pays nothing. You get a chat line when interest arrives: "Your bank paid N in interest today (1%, up to 5,000)."
Interest is paid only when you log in, so missing a day costs you that day's interest. It does not stack up.
Put coins you are saving for something expensive into the bank at the end of each session. A balance of 100,000 earns 1,000 a day.
There are two ways to send coins to another player. Both do the same checks.
Pick someone from the list of online players. Narrow screens show the list first, then the payment panel with a back arrow.

On the Pay page, a payment of 10,000 coins or more, or of half your purse or more, asks you to click again within 4 seconds to confirm. The page says how much of your purse it is.
